highlights.title: Overview
highlights.value: The University of Melbourne is Australia’s leading university, consistently ranked among the top in the world for research, teaching and graduate outcomes. It offers a wide range of undergraduate, postgraduate and specialist courses across disciplines such as Arts, Business, Science, Engineering, Law, Health, Education and Design.

highlights.title: Student life
highlights.value: You’ll find a welcoming, energetic campus culture with over 200 clubs and societies. The university offers structured programmes to help you settle in and connect, such as the Peer Mentor Programme and Academic Mentoring. Plus, you’ll be among 50,000+ students from over 150 nationalities.

highlights.title: Accommodation
highlights.value:
The university offers a wide range of accommodation options. You can choose from independent apartment–style options and residential colleges. University-managed residences such as Lisa Bellear House, Little Hall and The Lofts at Melbourne Connect offer fully furnished rooms, utilities, study spaces, gyms, and more.

If you’re looking for budget-friendly accommodation options outside the campus, feel free to download our app and check out the Stays feature!

highlights.title: Facilities
highlights.value:
Library
The university’s library system offers you extensive physical and digital collections, support services and study spaces.

Sports
You can access a wide range of sporting facilities through Melbourne University Sport, including fitness centres, competitive clubs, and outdoor activities.

Laboratory
On campus, you’ll find several research spaces and specialist laboratories for various fields of study.

Cafeteria
You can dine at 20+ cafes on campus, with plenty of places to relax.
